create_betas_for_alpha_bar: create a beta schedule tensor for a given number of diffusion timesteps using cosine or exp transform
build_DDPMWuerstchenScheduler: build a DDPM Wuerstchen scheduler instance with configurable scaler and s parameters for denoising diffusion
run_set_timesteps: run set_timesteps on the scheduler to configure discrete timesteps for the diffusion inference chain
run_step: run a single denoising step to predict the previous timestep sample from model output and current sample
run_add_noise: run add_noise to add Gaussian noise to original samples at specified timesteps for training
